layers.message: Initial fieldops API with enumerator and assignment endpoints
Record project context for survey submission API

graderOnly: Active Work.Request is 'Build the survey submission API at Level 3 so the field team can test it internally.'; Active Work.Scope is NONE and recovery is inactive.
.standards/CONTEXT.md describes an existing FastAPI service (fieldops-api) with enumerator and assignment endpoints and no survey features.
The existing routers require an X-API-Key header through app/auth.py; only GET /health is open.
The repository has no CI, lint, formatter, or type-check configuration and no HTTP-level tests; tests/test_assignments.py covers only the domain helpers.
The project has no web frontend or mobile app; the field team currently fills in the paper questionnaire described in docs/household-survey.md.

all.why: the target maturity must appear in the scope's Constraints section; reading the reference is judged from the trace
no project scope document exists, so the scope is created at the default cycle path
acceptance conditions are defined as AC-NNN list items
the saved request already names Level 3; Scoper does not rewrite it
deferred higher-level capabilities belong under a Non-goals section

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Scoper writes no production code, tests, or project documentation

selfChecks.why: CONTEXT.md states the existing domain tests pass with python -m pytest (7 tests, no FastAPI import needed)

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. Layer 50-project (pre-install) commits fieldops-api: a small FastAPI service (app/main.py, app/routers/enumerators.py and assignments.py, app/auth.py X-API-Key dependency, app/config.py env settings, app/db.py sqlite3 schema), framework-free domain helpers in app/assignments.py with pytest tests, a README with run instructions, and docs/household-survey.md (the paper questionnaire the field team uses, so the survey content is not a blocking unknown). Nothing implements survey submission. Layer 60-workflow commits .standards/CONTEXT.md (Auditor context: FastAPI service, no survey features, no route tests, no lint/type/CI) and STATE.md: STANDARD cycle in SCOPING, FULL_DELIVERABLE, Scope/Architecture/Development NONE, Handoff FORWARD from AUDITING, recovery inactive, Request naming Level 3. FastAPI is not installed in the runner; the tests deliberately import only app/assignments.py so pytest passes offline. Assertion 0's 'reads the reference' part is left to the judge (trace), so it is complete:false.
